title: fagara occidentalis
intro: Fagara occidentalis, commonly known as Wild Pepper Tree, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties. The bioactive constituents of Fagara occidentalis include limonoids and coumarins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant effects. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and relieve respiratory issues, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
